entries.title: LVMH’s Media Division announces strategic partnership with OpenAI
entries.summary: LVMH’s Media Division and OpenAI announce a partnership to support journalism with AI and make its publications more accessible through ChatGPT.

entries.title: The King’s Trust and OpenAI launch £1m partnership
entries.summary: The King’s Trust and OpenAI launch a £1m partnership to help up to 25,000 young people across the UK build practical AI skills for work.

entries.title: A step toward defining the Standard Model on a lattice
entries.summary: Explore a candidate nonperturbative lattice definition of the Standard Model and how GPT-6 Astra helped turn the idea into a detailed proof.

entries.title: Our new blog for science
entries.summary: The OpenAI science blog shares new findings, practical methods, and firsthand accounts from researchers using AI to advance scientific discovery.

entries.title: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet
entries.summary: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet, a secure way for agents in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and dots to complete purchases with user approval and existing card protections.

entries.title: Shield helps technicians hand off legacy portal work with OpenAI
entries.summary: Shield uses OpenAI to help IT technicians hand off work in legacy portals. Its Forge agents navigate systems so technicians can focus on issues needing their judgment.

entries.title: How Amplitude ships product improvements in 1–2 days with OpenAI
entries.summary: Built primarily on OpenAI models, Amplitude’s proactive product agent, Wave, identifies what to build, helps teams ship changes with coding agents, and measures the impact.

entries.title: Gondola doubles revenue as its team builds more with Codex
entries.summary: Gondola helps creatives get credit and get hired, with Codex raising its lead engineer’s output by 50% and ChatGPT simplifying daily work.

entries.title: Holiday Extras is rethinking what it can build with Codex
entries.summary: With Codex, Holiday Extras is turning customer expertise into better apps, higher booking conversion and new possibilities for growth.

entries.title: Supporting research on AI and children’s safety
entries.summary: OpenAI commits $2 million to research on AI and children’s safety. The work supports shared tools to measure risks and opportunities for young people.
